interpretation: Conditional exploratory stability, not independent validation, causal form evidence or a population confidence level. Fractional pseudo-count smoothing is a heuristic, not exact DM maximum likelihood.
null: Theme allocation patterns permuted globally; room concept weights and theme counts retained; theme allocation frequencies retained; concept category totals need not be retained. Frozen mean and concentration throughout.
bootstrap: Fit weighted duplicate draws; compare unique observed case identities once; retain a draw for k only with more than k distinct cases. Eligible k <= min(12, floor(n/2)).

accounting.third_tier: All recorded placements split equally as fractional weights; descriptive sensitivity only.

third_tier.interpretation: Sparse tier agreement is descriptive; no form claim or independence inference.
